US warplanes struck an Iranian missile launch site on Qeshm Island on 17 November, US military officials said; Iran then fired drones at Kuwait and Bahrain, and both said they repelled the attacks.
Ukraine brought down a road section of the Crimean Bridge on 17 November; Russia says a third attack on 19 November halted rail traffic.
Trump met Vladimir Putin for nearly an hour and then Xi Jinping in Shenzhen on 19 November, ahead of their first three-way meeting.
Two tankers were hit near Khasab on 16-17 November; one seafarer from each is missing and 11 crew were injured on an ADNOC vessel.
Russia flew two nuclear-capable Tu-95 bombers to Vietnam, and Japan scrambled jets after Russian aircraft entered its airspace on 17 November.
Israeli tanks crossed the Gaza ceasefire line on 18 November in the first armoured incursion since the truce; Hamas called it a blatant violation.
Russian missiles damaged Kyiv's two main Dnipro bridges on 17 November as attacks across Ukraine killed 14 people.
A senior Pentagon official said Ukraine's deep strikes into Russia were not working; Germany and Britain rejected the criticism.
